map.输入可接受的误差幅度、置信水平与总体标准差，估算估计总体均值所需的最小样本量 n: Enter the acceptable error, confidence level, and population standard deviation to estimate the minimum sample size n needed to estimate the population mean, so sampling is planned precisely enough in surveys or experiments to avoid excessive error.
map.均值估计 n = ⌈(z·σ / e)²⌉；比例估计 n = ⌈z²·p(1−p: Mean estimate n = ⌈(z·σ / e)²⌉; proportion estimate n = ⌈z²·p(1−p) / e²⌉
map.按给定置信水平反解 z 后估计最小样本量：均值估计用 n = (z·σ/e)²，: After back-solving z from the confidence level, estimate the minimum sample size: for a mean use n = (z·σ/e)² with σ the estimated population standard deviation and e the allowable error; for a proportion use n = z²·p(1−p)/e² with p the expected proportion. The result is rounded up to an integer, for sampling plans in surveys and experiments.
map.由置信水平查临界 z/t 值。: Look up the critical z/t value from the confidence level.
map.区间宽度随置信水平增大。: The interval widens as the confidence level rises.
map.：双尾 95% 对应 z=1.96（每尾 2.5%）；99% 对应 z=2.57: : a two-tailed 95% corresponds to z=1.96 (2.5% per tail); 99% corresponds to z=2.576 (0.5% per tail).
map.：提置信到 99% 区间更宽（更保守但更含糊），是精度与把握的权衡。: : raising confidence to 99% widens the interval (more conservative but vaguer) — a trade-off between precision and assurance.
map.由数值序列求样本标准差: Sample standard deviation from a data series
map.由样本均值、假设均值与标准差求 t 值: t-value from sample mean, hypothesized mean, and standard deviation
map.置信水平越高越好？: Is a Higher Confidence Level Always Better?
map.越高区间越宽、越不精确；选 95% 是惯例平衡，特殊领域用 99% 或 90%。: The higher the level the wider and less precise the interval; 95% is the customary balance, while specialized fields use 99% or 90%.
map.z 和 t 临界区别？: What's the Difference Between the z and t Critical Values?
map.小样本/σ 未知用 t 临界（随 df 变、略大于 z）；大样本 t≈z。: For small samples or unknown σ use the t critical value (it varies with df and is slightly larger than z); for large samples t ≈ z.
